list.label: Customer
list.query: SELECT custName AS __text, customerMH AS __value FROM reporting.sm_customermhs WHERE customerMH NOT IN (0,1) AND custDestroyTime IS NULL ORDER BY custName
list.definition: SELECT custName AS __text, customerMH AS __value FROM reporting.sm_customermhs WHERE customerMH NOT IN (0,1) AND custDestroyTime IS NULL ORDER BY custName

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.monitorMH) AS services FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN reporting.sm_slmuses su ON su.monitorMH=m.monitorMH AND su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL JOIN reporting.sm_customermhs cm ON cm.customerMH=su.customerMH WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND cm.customerMH IN ($customer)

WITH c AS (SELECT cust.* FROM reporting.sm_customers cust JOIN reporting.sm_customermhs cm ON cust.custName=cm.custName WHERE cm.customerMH IN ($customer) AND cm.customerMH<>1 LIMIT 1) SELECT ord, Attribute, Value FROM (SELECT 1 ord,'Customer' Attribute, CAST(custName AS CHAR) Value FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 2,'Customer ID', CAST(customerID AS CHAR) FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 3,'Criticality', CAST(custCriticality AS CHAR) FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 4,'Primary Contact', primContName FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 5,'Primary Title', primContTitle FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 6,'Primary Location', primContLocation FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 7,'Primary Phone', primPhone FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 8,'Primary Mobile', primMobile FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 9,'Primary Email', primEmail FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 10,'Secondary Contact', secContName FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 11,'Secondary Title', secContTitle FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 12,'Secondary Location', secContLocation FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 13,'Secondary Phone', secPhone FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 14,'Secondary Mobile', secMobile FROM c UNION ALL SELECT 15,'Secondary Email', secEmail FROM c) z ORDER BY ord

SELECT m.monName AS `Service`, m.monitorMH AS `monitorMH`, m.monDescription AS `Location/Desc`, COALESCE(sh.serviceHealthName,'Up') AS `Current Health`, ROUND(100*(1 - COALESCE(o.down_secs,0)/TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST($__timeFrom(), m.monCreateTime), $__timeTo())),4) AS `Availability %` FROM reporting.sm_monitors m JOIN reporting.sm_slmuses su ON su.monitorMH=m.monitorMH AND su.usesDestroyTime IS NULL JOIN reporting.sm_customermhs cm ON cm.customerMH=su.customerMH LEFT JOIN (SELECT mm.monitorMH AS mh, SUM(GREATEST(0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, GREATEST(mo.startTime,$__timeFrom()), LEAST(COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo()),$__timeTo())))) AS down_secs FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo ON mm.monOutageID=mo.monOutageID WHERE mo.serviceHealth IN ($downStates) AND mo.outageType<=1 AND mo.startTime<$__timeTo() AND COALESCE(mo.endTime,$__timeTo())>$__timeFrom() GROUP BY mm.monitorMH) o ON o.mh=m.monitorMH LEFT JOIN reporting.sm_servicehealth sh ON sh.serviceHealth=(SELECT mox.serviceHealth FROM reporting.sm_monitoroutages mox WHERE mox.monOutageID=(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN mo3.serviceHealth!=10 THEN mo3.monOutageID END), MAX(mo3.monOutageID)) FROM reporting.sm_monitormaps mm3 JOIN reporting.sm_monitoroutages mo3 ON mm3.monOutageID=mo3.monOutageID WHERE mm3.monitorMH=m.monitorMH)) WHERE m.monitorType=0 AND m.monDestroyTime IS NULL AND m.monitorMH NOT IN (0,1) AND cm.customerMH IN ($customer) ORDER BY `Availability %` ASC
